instanceGeneral.title: General
instanceGeneral.modeLocalTrusted: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
instanceGeneral.modePublic: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
instanceGeneral.modePrivate: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.
instanceGeneral.censorUsernameDescription: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.
instanceGeneral.backupRetentionDescription: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.
instanceGeneral.aiFeedbackDescription: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
instanceGeneral.noDefaultSaved: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
instanceGeneral.dontAllowDescription: Keep voted AI outputs local only.

Menções isoladas ao nome de usuário fora de caminhos ainda não são mascaradas na visualização em tempo real da transcrição. Isso fica desativado por padrão.
instanceGeneral.censorUsernameAria: Alternar censura de nome de usuário nos logs
instanceGeneral.backupRetentionDescription: Configure por quanto tempo os backups automáticos do banco de dados são mantidos. Os backups são executados aproximadamente a cada hora e compactados com gzip. Dentro da janela diária, todos os backups são mantidos; além disso, preserva-se um backup por semana e um por mês.
